about.title: Graphic Tool JML
about.description: Directional typographic composition tool based on the JML visual identity. Developed for internal use by the Grapheine and JML Water Feature Design teams.
about.step1: Type any text in the canvas.
about.step2: Click a letter to select it.
about.step3: Activate one or more extension directions — up, down, left, right. Each direction is an independent toggle: click to activate, click again to deactivate. Multiple directions can be active on the same letter simultaneously.
about.step4: Adjust the number of slices with the slider (1 → 6).
about.step5: Export as vector SVG or PNG 300 dpi with transparent background.
about.spec.directionsValue: Up to 4 directions active simultaneously per letter
about.spec.svgValue: Native vector paths - compatible with Adobe Illustrator
